recognize_zh: H&E 下大型組織球細胞質豐富淡染、胞質內包著一整群小淋巴球與漿細胞（emperipolesis，中央與左下兩群最清楚），周圍有細胞質空泡與淋巴漿細胞背景，是 Rosai-Dorfman disease 的特徵畫面。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated eosinophilic cytoplasm
Striking emperipolesis: clusters of 10-20 intact small lymphocytes within single histiocytes (center and lower left)
Engulfed cells retain intact nuclei, some with a surrounding clear halo, including plasma cells
Histiocyte nuclei are oval with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, partly obscured by engulfed cells
Background small lymphocytes and plasma cells with vacuolated stroma and clear spaces
describe_en: Sections show sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei. Several histiocytes contain numerous intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within their cytoplasm, forming prominent clusters of emperipolesis. The background consists of small lymphocytes and plasma cells without significant atypia. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease, which would be supported by S100 and OCT2 positivity in the histiocytes with CD1a negativity.

ddx.vs: Shows grooved nuclei with eosinophils and CD1a/langerin positivity, lacking intact lymphocytes within histiocyte cytoplasm.
Macrophages phagocytose and degrade red cells, platelets and nucleated cells (true phagocytosis) and are S100 negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and keratin or melanocytic markers, and cell-in-cell engulfment is not organized emperipolesis.
Histiocytes are smaller, S100 negative and lack clusters of engulfed lymphocytes.
